title: 第3章 黄鼠狼给鸡拜年第4章 寻一方靠山拜入武馆
content_zh:
;;
日头渐高。
林青来到青云岭山脚下，人迹罕至的溪涧。
他仔细清洗身上干涸的血迹污泥。
直至确认再无任何污迹残留，才略略安心。
归途，他择了一条迂回小径。
虽远了些，但能避开官道上的诸多人流。
林青一路小心翼翼，穿林过涧。
直至清平县在望，林青紧绷的心，才稍稍松弛下来。
城门处颇为热闹，等待入城的菜贩、行商排成长龙。
几名守城兵卒歪戴缨帽，抱着长枪，对过往百姓挑挑拣拣，不时厉声呵斥，搜刮些零碎好处。
轮到林青时，一个眼角带疤的城卒瞥见他肩后满满当当的药篓，懒洋洋用枪杆敲了敲篓沿。
“采药的？”
“军爷明鉴，我是城内济世堂的人。”
林青解释。
今日守城的官差似乎换了一批。
没以往的那么好说话了。
“我管你是谁，药篓打开看看。”
疤脸城卒不耐烦的挥手。
林青依言掀开破布一角，露出里面杂乱普通的草药。

那城卒探手入内，熟稔地翻拣几下。
将几株品相稍好的药材揣入怀中。
动作行云流水，显然习以为常。
他掂了掂手中的草药，又看向竹篓，见再无油水可捞，这才摆了摆手：“行了，滚吧。”
林青敢怒不敢言，只得快步穿过城门。
这世道，官字两张口。
底层百姓，便是那随意揉捏的面团。
……
回到永宁街时，日头已升得老高。
济世堂还在店门紧闭，颇为冷清。
他刚走近自家后院门扉，隔壁院门“吱呀”一声开了。
content_en:
;;
The sun is getting higher.
Lin Qing came to the inaccessible stream at the foot of Qingyunling Mountain.
He carefully washed the dried blood and mud off his body.
Only when you are sure that there are no more stains left will you feel at ease.
On his way home, he chose a circuitous path.
Although it is far away, it can avoid the many crowds on the official road.
Lin Qing walked carefully through the woods and streams.
It wasn't until Qingping County was in sight that Lin Qing's tense heart relaxed a little.
The city gate was quite lively, with a long queue of vegetable vendors and merchants waiting to enter the city.
Several soldiers guarding the city, wearing tasseled hats and holding spears, were picking at the passing people, scolding them from time to time, and looking for some scraps and benefits.
When it was Lin Qing's turn, a city soldier with a scar at the corner of his eye caught a glimpse of the full medicine basket behind his shoulder, and lazily tapped the edge of the basket with the barrel of his gun.
"A medicine collector?"
"Master Mingjian, I am from Jishi Hall in the city."
Lin Qing explained.
There seems to be a new batch of officers guarding the city today.
Not as easy to talk to as before.
"I don't care who you are, open the medicine basket and take a look."
The scar-faced city soldier waved his hand impatiently.
Lin Qing followed her instructions and opened a corner of the rag, revealing the messy and ordinary herbs inside.
The city soldier put his hand inside and rummaged through it a few times.
Put a few medicinal herbs in good condition into your arms.
His movements were smooth and flowing, obviously he was used to it.
He weighed the herbs in his hands and looked at the bamboo basket. Seeing that there was no more oil or water to fish out, he waved his hand: "Okay, get out of here."
Lin Qing dared not speak out in anger, so she had to walk through the city gate quickly.
In this world, there are two words for official.
The people at the bottom are like the dough that is kneaded at will.
…
When we returned to Yongning Street, the sun was already high.
Jishitang is still closed, quite deserted.
As soon as he approached the door to his backyard, the door to the next door opened with a creak.
